description: Canterbury Earthquake Survey Mark Movements is a dataset listed in LINZ Data Service (data.linz.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by Survey & Title. This layer details the movement of survey marks due to the Canterbury Earthquake Sequence (CES). The movements include the impact of 5 major earthquakes on 4 September 2010, 22 February 2011, 13 June 2011, 23 December 2011 and 14 February 2016. Note that these movements apply only at the survey mark. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher Survey & Title. Its tags are HAZARDS-Earthquake, LAND-Cadastre, LAND-Geodesy, New Zealand. It offers 1 resource(s) in vector. The portal shows 2026-08-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-linz-portal.
